-- Vias da CTO TESTE 3 (ctoId=77, element_id=95)
SELECT cv.id, cv.tubeId, cv.viaNumber, cv.label, cv.fusedToTubeId, cv.fusedToViaId
FROM cto_vias cv
JOIN cto_tubes ct ON ct.id = cv.tubeId
WHERE ct.ctoId = 77
ORDER BY cv.tubeId, cv.viaNumber;
